A 1000 kg car moving with an acceleration of 4 m s⁻² covers a distance of 50 m in 5 seconds. What is the power generated by its engine?

SOLUTION:
Mass of car  m = 1000 kg
Acceleration  a = 4 m s⁻²
Distance  S = 50 m
Time taken  t = 5 s
Power  P = ?

First, we shall determine the force applied by Newton's second law.

F = ma = 1000 kg × 4 m s⁻² = 4000 N

From Eq. (5.1), Work, W = FS

Or  W = 4000 N × 50 m = 2.0 × 10⁵ J

From Eq. (5.5), P = W/t

Putting the values of W and t, we have

P = (2.0 × 10⁵ J)/(5 s) = 4 × 10¹ W = 40 kW
